categories.main_business_segments: Zhuhai Century Dingli Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: communication business and vocational education business. The communication segment focuses on wireless network optimization products, network optimization, and technical services for telecom operators and equipment manufacturers. The vocational education segment provides educational services and equipment mainly through the 'Dingli Academy' initiative, collaborating with domestic higher vocational colleges to offer integrated education and training solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced 5G and 5G-Advanced (5G-A) wireless communication technologies, developing multi-dimensional, multi-scenario network testing instruments and software platforms. It emphasizes proprietary R&D in mobile communication network optimization, including intelligent network testing devices and data management platforms. In vocational education, it employs the UBL (Ultrawise Blended Link) industry-education integration model, combining real industry projects with education to enhance practical skills training.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic telecom operators such as China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Tower, as well as telecom equipment manufacturers like ZTE. The vocational education business serves higher vocational colleges and students seeking academic and skill advancement. The company also targets emerging markets in industrial IoT and digital economy sectors, expanding beyond traditional telecom clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant revenue contributions from regions including East China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, and North China. It also has overseas operations and subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Thailand, and Sri Lanka, focusing on manufacturing and energy sectors. The company’s products and services are deployed in over 300 cities domestically and have international reach through its subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Century Dingli operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the telecom supply chain, providing network testing instruments, optimization services, and integrated solutions to telecom operators and equipment manufacturers. In vocational education, it functions downstream by delivering education services and equipment to academic institutions. It also engages in manufacturing of communication devices and educational equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in 5G-A wireless network testing and data analysis platforms, aiming to commercialize advanced 5G-A testing solutions. It focuses on integrating AI with 5G technologies to capture new market opportunities. Vocational education R&D emphasizes digital transformation, smart teaching platforms, and deepening industry-education integration to enhance talent cultivation quality. The company also pursues cost optimization and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of wireless network optimization products, network optimization and technical services via public bidding contracts, and vocational education services including academy operations and educational equipment sales. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and occasional asset disposals. Sales are predominantly direct to telecom operators, equipment manufacturers, and educational institutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Century Dingli is positioned as a leading domestic provider of mobile communication network optimization solutions and vocational education services in China. It competes with other telecom equipment suppliers and network service providers, facing increasing market concentration and competition from larger players. In vocational education, it competes with emerging education service providers amid policy-driven industry expansion. The company leverages its technology, brand, and integrated service capabilities to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 281.77 million, a 22.2% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.4 million, though the loss narrowed significantly compared to prior years. Total assets stood at about RMB 618 million, with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 395 million. The company has experienced revenue contraction but is focusing on stabilizing core businesses and improving profitability through strategic adjustments and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Century Dingli emphasizes its comprehensive, end-to-end wireless network optimization solutions backed by strong proprietary R&D and industry certifications. Its products support advanced 5G and 5G-A technologies, offering high stability and adaptability in complex environments. The vocational education segment differentiates through its UBL blended learning model, integrating real industry projects with education to enhance practical skills and employment outcomes. The company’s dual focus on communication and education sectors creates synergistic value and sustainable competitive advantages.
